# Timestamp (unixstamp.dev)

> Local-first Unix timestamp converter: seconds or milliseconds ↔ UTC and browser local date-time, entirely in the browser.

## Pages

- [Converter](https://unixstamp.dev/): Bidirectional Unix seconds/milliseconds ↔ UTC ISO 8601 and local date-time converter with millisecond precision and one-click copy.
- [FAQ](https://unixstamp.dev/faq): Answers on Unix timestamps, seconds vs. milliseconds, Local vs. UTC interpretation, DST handling, precision/range, and privacy.

## Privacy & Architecture

- All timestamp conversions run locally in the browser; entered values are never sent over the network, stored, or placed in URLs.
- Self-hosted OpenPanel analytics (`https://openpanel.themkvz.com`) record page views and UI interaction metadata only, never entered values or results.
